# Lifecycle Governance of Experience for Coding Agents

###### Abstract
We show that the bottleneck in experience reuse is not retrieval fidelity but how experience is stored and governed across its lifecycle. An in-loop recall gate improves resolution from 24.9% to 27.6% while lowering cost for agent memory. The method is evaluated on several public benchmarks and compared against strong baselines under matched budgets.
